proof_body:
-- DPDA with states 0 (reading a's), 1 (reading b's), 2 (all b's matched), 3 (reading c's, accepting);
  -- stack symbols: `false` = bottom marker, `true` = one pending `a`.
  let M : DPDA (Fin 4) Letter Bool :=
    { initial_state := 0
      start_symbol := false
      final_states := {3}
      transition := fun q x Z =>
        match q, x, Z with
        | 0, Letter.a, false => some (0, [true, false])
        | 0, Letter.a, true => some (0, [true, true])
        | 0, Letter.b, true => some (1, [])
        | 1, Letter.b, true => some (1, [])
        | 2, Letter.c, false => some (3, [false])
        | 3, Letter.c, false => some (3, [false])
        | _, _, _ => none
      epsilon_transition := fun q Z =>
        match q, Z with
        | 1, false => some (2, [false])
        | _, _ => none
      no_mixed := by decide }
  refine ⟨Fin 4, Bool, inferInstance, inferInstance, M, ?_⟩
  -- One-step facts.
  have s0a : ∀ (rest : List Letter) (stk : List Bool),
      PDA.Reaches₁ (pda := M.toPDA) ⟨0, Letter.a :: rest, false :: stk⟩ ⟨0, rest, true :: false :: stk⟩ := by
    intro rest stk
    simp [PDA.Reaches₁, PDA.step, DPDA.toPDA, M]
  have s0a' : ∀ (rest : List Letter) (stk : List Bool),
      PDA.Reaches₁ (pda := M.toPDA) ⟨0, Letter.a :: rest, true :: stk⟩ ⟨0, rest, true :: true :: stk⟩ := by
    intro rest stk
    simp [PDA.Reaches₁, PDA.step, DPDA.toPDA, M]
  have s0b : ∀ (rest : List Letter) (stk : List Bool),
      PDA.Reaches₁ (pda := M.toPDA) ⟨0, Letter.b :: rest, true :: stk⟩ ⟨1, rest, stk⟩ := by
    intro rest stk
    simp [PDA.Reaches₁, PDA.step, DPDA.toPDA, M]
  have s1b : ∀ (rest : List Letter) (stk : List Bool),
      PDA.Reaches₁ (pda := M.toPDA) ⟨1, Letter.b :: rest, true :: stk⟩ ⟨1, rest, stk⟩ := by
    intro rest stk
    simp [PDA.Reaches₁, PDA.step, DPDA.toPDA, M]
  have s1e : ∀ (rest : List Letter),
      PDA.Reaches₁ (pda := M.toPDA) ⟨1, rest, [false]⟩ ⟨2, rest, [false]⟩ := by
    intro rest
    cases rest <;> simp [PDA.Reaches₁, PDA.step, DPDA.toPDA, M]
  have s2c : ∀ (rest : List Letter),
      PDA.Reaches₁ (pda := M.toPDA) ⟨2, Letter.c :: rest, [false]⟩ ⟨3, rest, [false]⟩ := by
    intro rest
    simp [PDA.Reaches₁, PDA.step, DPDA.toPDA, M]
  have s3c : ∀ (rest : List Letter),
      PDA.Reaches₁ (pda := M.toPDA) ⟨3, Letter.c :: rest, [false]⟩ ⟨3, rest, [false]⟩ := by
    intro rest
    simp [PDA.Reaches₁, PDA.step, DPDA.toPDA, M]
  -- Multi-step facts: push k more a's, pop k b's, read k c's.
  have readA : ∀ (k : ℕ) (rest : List Letter) (stk : List Bool),
      PDA.Reaches (pda := M.toPDA) ⟨0, List.replicate k Letter.a ++ rest, true :: stk⟩
        ⟨0, rest, List.replicate k true ++ true :: stk⟩ := by
    intro k
    induction k with
    | zero => intro rest stk; exact Relation.ReflTransGen.refl
    | succ k ih =>
      intro rest stk
      refine Relation.ReflTransGen.head (s0a' (List.replicate k Letter.a ++ rest) stk) ?_
      simpa [List.replicate_succ', List.append_assoc] using ih rest (true :: stk)
  have readB : ∀ (k : ℕ) (rest : List Letter) (stk : List Bool),
      PDA.Reaches (pda := M.toPDA) ⟨1, List.replicate k Letter.b ++ rest, List.replicate k true ++ stk⟩
        ⟨1, rest, stk⟩ := by
    intro k
    induction k with
    | zero => intro rest stk; exact Relation.ReflTransGen.refl
    | succ k ih =>
      intro rest stk
      refine Relation.ReflTransGen.head ?_ (ih rest stk)
      simpa [List.replicate_succ] using s1b (List.replicate k Letter.b ++ rest) (List.replicate k true ++ stk)
  have readC : ∀ (k : ℕ) (rest : List Letter),
      PDA.Reaches (pda := M.toPDA) ⟨3, List.replicate k Letter.c ++ rest, [false]⟩ ⟨3, rest, [false]⟩ := by
    intro k
    induction k with
    | zero => intro rest; exact Relation.ReflTransGen.refl
    | succ k ih =>
      intro rest
      refine Relation.ReflTransGen.head ?_ (ih rest)
      simpa [List.replicate_succ] using s3c (List.replicate k Letter.c ++ rest)
  -- Completeness: a^(m+1) b^(m+1) c^(p+1) is accepted.
  have complete : ∀ m p : ℕ, PDA.Reaches (pda := M.toPDA)
      ⟨0, List.replicate (m + 1) Letter.a ++ List.replicate (m + 1) Letter.b ++ List.replicate (p + 1) Letter.c,
        [false]⟩ ⟨3, [], [false]⟩ := by
    intro m p
    have e : ∀ n : ℕ, List.replicate n true ++ true :: [false] = true :: (List.replicate n true ++ [false]) := by
      intro n
      induction n with
      | zero => rfl
      | succ n ih => simp [List.replicate_succ, ih]
    have h1 := s0a (List.replicate m Letter.a ++ (List.replicate (m + 1) Letter.b ++ List.replicate (p + 1) Letter.c)) []
    have h2 := readA m (List.replicate (m + 1) Letter.b ++ List.replicate (p + 1) Letter.c) [false]
    rw [e m] at h2
    have h3 := s0b (List.replicate m Letter.b ++ List.replicate (p + 1) Letter.c) (List.replicate m true ++ [false])
    have h4 := readB m (List.replicate (p + 1) Letter.c) [false]
    have h5 := s1e (List.replicate (p + 1) Letter.c)
    have h6 := s2c (List.replicate p Letter.c)
    have h7 := readC p []
    simp only [List.append_nil] at h7
    simp only [List.replicate_succ, List.cons_append, List.append_assoc] at h1 h3 h4 h5 h6 ⊢
    exact Relation.ReflTransGen.head h1 (h2.trans (Relation.ReflTransGen.head h3 (h4.trans
      (Relation.ReflTransGen.head h5 (Relation.ReflTransGen.head h6 h7)))))
  -- Soundness: invariant of every configuration reachable from the start.
  have inv : ∀ (w : List Letter) (c : PDA.conf M.toPDA),
      PDA.Reaches (pda := M.toPDA) ⟨0, w, [false]⟩ c →
      ∃ i j k : ℕ, w = List.replicate i Letter.a ++ List.replicate j Letter.b ++ List.replicate k Letter.c ++ c.input ∧
        ((c.state = 0 ∧ j = 0 ∧ k = 0 ∧ c.stack = List.replicate i true ++ [false]) ∨
         (c.state = 1 ∧ 1 ≤ j ∧ j ≤ i ∧ k = 0 ∧ c.stack = List.replicate (i - j) true ++ [false]) ∨
         (c.state = 2 ∧ i = j ∧ 1 ≤ i ∧ k = 0 ∧ c.stack = [false]) ∨
         (c.state = 3 ∧ i = j ∧ 1 ≤ i ∧ 1 ≤ k ∧ c.stack = [false])) := by
    intro w c h
    induction h with
    | refl => exact ⟨0, 0, 0, by simp, Or.inl ⟨rfl, rfl, rfl, by simp⟩⟩
    | @tail b c' _ hstep ih =>
      obtain ⟨i, j, k, hw, hcases⟩ := ih
      rcases b with ⟨q, inp, stk⟩
      rcases hcases with ⟨rfl, rfl, rfl, rfl⟩ | ⟨rfl, hj1, hji, rfl, rfl⟩ | ⟨rfl, rfl, hi1, rfl, rfl⟩ |
        ⟨rfl, rfl, hi1, hk1, rfl⟩
      · -- state 0: reading a's
        rcases i with _ | i
        · rcases inp with _ | ⟨x, rest⟩
          · simp [PDA.Reaches₁, PDA.step, DPDA.toPDA, M] at hstep
          · cases x
            · simp [PDA.Reaches₁, PDA.step, DPDA.toPDA, M] at hstep
              subst hstep
              exact ⟨1, 0, 0, by simpa using hw, Or.inl ⟨rfl, rfl, rfl, by simp⟩⟩
            · simp [PDA.Reaches₁, PDA.step, DPDA.toPDA, M] at hstep
            · simp [PDA.Reaches₁, PDA.step, DPDA.toPDA, M] at hstep
        · rcases inp with _ | ⟨x, rest⟩
          · simp [List.replicate_succ, PDA.Reaches₁, PDA.step, DPDA.toPDA, M] at hstep
          · cases x
            · simp [List.replicate_succ, PDA.Reaches₁, PDA.step, DPDA.toPDA, M] at hstep
              subst hstep
              exact ⟨i + 2, 0, 0, by simpa [List.replicate_succ', List.append_assoc] using hw,
                Or.inl ⟨rfl, rfl, rfl, by simp [List.replicate_succ]⟩⟩
            · simp [List.replicate_succ, PDA.Reaches₁, PDA.step, DPDA.toPDA, M] at hstep
              subst hstep
              exact ⟨i + 1, 1, 0, by simpa using hw,
                Or.inr (Or.inl ⟨rfl, le_refl 1, by omega, rfl, by simp⟩)⟩
            · simp [List.replicate_succ, PDA.Reaches₁, PDA.step, DPDA.toPDA, M] at hstep
      · -- state 1: popping one `a` per `b` (1 ≤ j ≤ i)
        obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ : ∃ n, i - j = n := ⟨_, rfl⟩
        rw [hn] at hstep
        rcases n with _ | n
        · rcases inp with _ | ⟨x, rest⟩
          · simp [PDA.Reaches₁, PDA.step, DPDA.toPDA, M] at hstep
            subst hstep
            exact ⟨i, j, 0, by simpa using hw, Or.inr (Or.inr (Or.inl ⟨rfl, by omega, by omega, rfl, rfl⟩))⟩
          · cases x <;> simp [PDA.Reaches₁, PDA.step, DPDA.toPDA, M] at hstep <;> subst hstep <;>
              exact ⟨i, j, 0, by simpa using hw, Or.inr (Or.inr (Or.inl ⟨rfl, by omega, by omega, rfl, rfl⟩))⟩
        · rcases inp with _ | ⟨x, rest⟩
          · simp [List.replicate_succ, PDA.Reaches₁, PDA.step, DPDA.toPDA, M] at hstep
          · cases x
            · simp [List.replicate_succ, PDA.Reaches₁, PDA.step, DPDA.toPDA, M] at hstep
            · simp [List.replicate_succ, PDA.Reaches₁, PDA.step, DPDA.toPDA, M] at hstep
              subst hstep
              exact ⟨i, j + 1, 0, by simpa [List.replicate_succ', List.append_assoc] using hw,
                Or.inr (Or.inl ⟨rfl, by omega, by omega, rfl, by
                  have : i - (j + 1) = n := by omega
                  simp [this]⟩)⟩
            · simp [List.replicate_succ, PDA.Reaches₁, PDA.step, DPDA.toPDA, M] at hstep
      · -- state 2: only a `c` can follow
        rcases inp with _ | ⟨x, rest⟩
        · simp [PDA.Reaches₁, PDA.step, DPDA.toPDA, M] at hstep
        · cases x
          · simp [PDA.Reaches₁, PDA.step, DPDA.toPDA, M] at hstep
          · simp [PDA.Reaches₁, PDA.step, DPDA.toPDA, M] at hstep
          · simp [PDA.Reaches₁, PDA.step, DPDA.toPDA, M] at hstep
            subst hstep
            exact ⟨i, i, 1, by simpa using hw, Or.inr (Or.inr (Or.inr ⟨rfl, rfl, hi1, le_refl 1, rfl⟩))⟩
      · -- state 3: more c's
        rcases inp with _ | ⟨x, rest⟩
        · simp [PDA.Reaches₁, PDA.step, DPDA.toPDA, M] at hstep
        · cases x
          · simp [PDA.Reaches₁, PDA.step, DPDA.toPDA, M] at hstep
          · simp [PDA.Reaches₁, PDA.step, DPDA.toPDA, M] at hstep
          · simp [PDA.Reaches₁, PDA.step, DPDA.toPDA, M] at hstep
            subst hstep
            exact ⟨i, i, k + 1, by simpa [List.replicate_succ', List.append_assoc] using hw,
              Or.inr (Or.inr (Or.inr ⟨rfl, rfl, hi1, by omega, rfl⟩))⟩
  ext w
  constructor
  · -- an accepting run ends in state 3 with input a^i b^i c^k, i, k ≥ 1
    rintro ⟨q, hq, γ, hreach⟩
    obtain ⟨i, j, k, hw, hcases⟩ := inv w ⟨q, [], γ⟩ hreach
    have hq3 : q = 3 := by simpa [M, DPDA.toPDA] using hq
    rcases hcases with ⟨h0, -⟩ | ⟨h1, -⟩ | ⟨h2, -⟩ | ⟨-, hij, hi1, hk1, -⟩
    · simp [hq3] at h0
    · simp [hq3] at h1
    · simp [hq3] at h2
    · exact ⟨i, j, k, by simpa using hw, hi1, by omega, hk1, hij⟩
  · -- a^(m+1) b^(m+1) c^(p+1) is accepted
    rintro ⟨n_u, n_v, n_w, hw, hu, hv, hwc, huv⟩
    obtain ⟨m, rfl⟩ : ∃ m, n_u = m + 1 := ⟨n_u - 1, by omega⟩
    obtain ⟨p, rfl⟩ : ∃ p, n_w = p + 1 := ⟨n_w - 1, by omega⟩
    obtain rfl : n_v = m + 1 := by omega
    exact ⟨3, by simp [M], [false], by rw [hw]; exact complete m p⟩

DPDA over Fin 4 / Bool: push a mark per a, pop per b, epsilon-move on the bottom marker, then accept in state 3 while reading c's.
